title: G11 · 接受
body: I isolated the change to twoSumCount, adding an exact all-equal shortcut and a bounded-range Uint32Array counting path that replaces Map hashing for dense integer inputs while preserving the proven sparse fallback and exact i<j duplicate-pair semantics. The previously measured equivalent bounded strategy improved two-sum from 90.1× to 359× on holdout, projecting an unchanged-task aggregate near 54.1× versus the 47.8× acceptance threshold, while avoiding every unrelated change implicated in prior rejected generations.
